title: ModifierPrompt

external_id.description: A user-configured identifier for this object within the menu. External IDs must be unique across all menu entities of this type. Any modifier prompt that shares this `external_id` will be overwritten.

name.description: The text given to the diner to prompt then to select from a list of modifier options.

internal_name.description: A name displayed on Grubhub menu management tools instead of the display name.

modifier_list.description: An `external_id` reference to a PosNormalizedModifierList. This is the list of modifier options valid as answers to this prompt.

modifier_quantity_settings.description: Quantity information for a single modifier within this prompt.

defaulted_modifiers.description: The modifiers, if any, that are selected by default for this prompt.

items.description: The modifiers, if any, that are selected by default for this prompt.

description: In a normalized menu, a question posed to a diner about what additional options they would like with their food; for example, toppings on a pizza or soup options in a lunch special. Each modifier prompts has one or more modifiers that a diner can select. Modifier prompts can apply to multiple menu items.

minimum_units.description: The total minimum quantity that must be selected across all modifiers in a prompt.

maximum_units.description: The total maximum quantity that can be selected across all modifiers in a prompt. *DO NOT use -1 as an integer for unlimited quantity. Instead use a high number, ie 99.*

ModifierPromptQuantitySettings.description: The total minimum and maximum quantities that can be added for all modifier options in this prompt.

minimum_quantity.description: The minimum number of unique options that the diner can select for this prompt. Use 0 to set no minimum.

maximum_quantity.description: The maximum number of unique options that the diner can select for this prompt. *DO NOT use -1 as an integer for unlimited quantity. Instead use a high number, ie 99.*

ModifierPromptSelectionSettings.description: The minimum and maximum number of unique modifier options that can be selected within a prompt.

default_units.description: The number of units of this modifier already entered into the interface when the diner first selects these associated menu item. Applies only to default_modifiers.

maximum_units.description: The maximum number of units that the diner can add of this modifier. Do not use zero as a maximum integer or the modifiers will not be selectable. *DO NOT use -1 as an integer for unlimited quantity. Instead use a high number, ie 99.*

unit_increment.description: The number of units added per incremental or decremental action.

ModifierQuantitySettings.description: Contains default, maximum, and custom increments for a single modifier. The properties below will be contained in a sub-object identified by the external_id of the modifier in question.
